name: What is the difference between cabinet refacing and replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between cabinet refacing and replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet refacing involves keeping the existing cabinet boxes and replacing the doors, drawer fronts, and applying a new veneer to the exposed cabinet frames. This is a more cost-effective and less disruptive option. Cabinet replacement involves removing all existing cabinets and installing entirely new ones, allowing for a complete redesign of your kitchen layout and functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Refacing updates cabinet exteriors while keeping boxes; replacement involves removing and installing all new cabinets.
